title: [P1] Payment Gateway Complete Outage
body: Critical production outage affecting all payment processing. Customer transactions failing with 503 errors. Revenue impact estimated at $50K/hour.

title: [P2] Authentication Service Degraded Performance
body: Login latency increased from 200ms to 3.2s. Affecting user experience but service is operational.

title: [SEV1] Database Connection Pool Exhausted
body: Primary database connection pool at 100% capacity. Application servers unable to acquire connections. Cascading failures across multiple services.

title: [P1] Order Processing System Down
body: Order processing pipeline completely halted. Orders stuck in pending state. Customer support receiving high volume of complaints.

title: [P3] Notification Service Delayed
body: Email notifications delayed by 15 minutes. Non-critical but affecting user experience.

title: [P2] API Rate Limiting Errors
body: Third-party API integration hitting rate limits. Causing intermittent failures in data sync operations.
